messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - ZetaBank (tenant zeta-bank-prod) - Observability ingestion gap detected for dedicated pool 'db-dedicated-42'. Traces missing, partial logs. Paging on-call. Incident ID INC-2026-3456.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Can someone post initial impact numbers?

sre-arch-priya: Looking at console metrics: dedicated pool 'db-dedicated-42' shows spike in forwarder errors at 2026-04-15T03:07Z. Trace ingestion rate for tenant zeta-bank-prod -> 0 spans/sec since 03:06Z. Logs show 502s from forwarder to obs-gateway.

account-se-jen: Customer (ZetaBank) just reported they cannot see traces for recent transactions in prod. They're on a dedicated VPC with private forwarding. They've started paging their on-call as well.

cust-sre-tom: Confirmed from Zeta side — dashboards show traces empty and alerts firing. Logs are partially present but missing span/context for ~95% of requests since 03:05Z.

oncall-sre: tl;dr: traces gone, some logs delayed, metrics delayed ~10-20m. Is this tenant-isolated or broader?

runtime-eng-marc: Initial read: it's tenant-scoped to zeta-bank-prod on that dedicated pool. Other tenants on same pool have degraded traces but are mostly OK. Hypothesis: forwarder routing table entry for tenant cert/role expired and forwarder is rejecting trace payloads, resulting in 502s.

observability-nyk: I'm seeing errors in forwarder: `auth: role mapping failed for tenant=zeta-bank-prod, status=403`. Also `span_id mapping missing` logs.

infra-ops-luis: Could be credential rotation hit - our role mapping service had a flake during the 03:05 maintenance window. I'm checking IAM policies and forwarder agent logs.

oncall-sre: Priority actions: 1) Give customer temporary access to raw logs/traces for investigation 2) Attempt restart of forwarder on affected nodes 3) Roll temporary bypass to accept traces from zeta-bank-prod until role mapping fixed.

sre-arch-priya: Agreed. For (2) try: `kubectl -n obs-forwarder rollout restart deploy/forwarder-db-dedicated-42` — that will recycle forwarder pods and rehydrate certs.

runtime-eng-marc: Running restart now. Output: `deployment.apps/forwarder-db-dedicated-42 restarted`

infra-ops-luis: I've checked KMS rotations — no recent rotation for zeta-bank-prod. But the role-mapping service returned 5xx at 03:05-03:08. I can push a patch to fallback to cached mapping. Pushing now.

observability-nyk: After restart, forwarder logs show reduced 502s but still some `403 role mapping` for ~10% of connections.

oncall-sre: @account-se-jen pls coordinate with Zeta on temporary workaround: can we enable a dedicated forwarder endpoint for them (signed URL S3/HTTPS) so they can ship spans while we fix role mapping?

account-se-jen: Reached out to Zeta via email/phone. They asked for ETA. I offered temporary signed ingestion endpoint. They asked that we avoid exposing any other tenant data.

sre-arch-priya: We can issue a tenant-scoped presigned ingestion key with strict ACL. Steps (manual): 1) create one-time ingestion key scoped to zeta-bank-prod 2) whitelist their IPs 3) point them at `https://ingest-ep.redwood-infra/presigned/<key>` 4) instruct them to swap endpoint in forwarder config.

cust-sre-tom: Can we get logs/trace replay for the missing window (03:05-03:15) to send to Zeta for triage?

observability-nyk: Full raw spans were not ingested; we only have partial application logs. We can export available logs to an S3 bucket and share a presigned URL. I'll prepare export.

infra-ops-luis: Patch to mapping service rolled out. It patches fallback to cached mapping and a short-circuit allowlist for verified-tenants list. Moving to canary now.

runtime-eng-marc: Canary shows mapping service ok, forwarders stop returning 403s after mapping patch. However, some nodes still have stale cached entries — need cache flush. Command: `kubectl -n obs-forwarder exec deploy/forwarder-db-dedicated-42 -- curl -sS localhost:9100/flush-cache`

oncall-sre: @runtime-eng-marc do that on all affected pods, please.

runtime-eng-marc: Running flush across pods. Responses: `cache flushed` x4. Monitoring traces ingestion...

observability-nyk: Traces are trickling back in. For zeta-bank-prod: span ingestion at 03:23Z resumed to ~70% of baseline; by 03:30Z we're at 95%. Logs backlog being processed, metrics lag ~12 minutes.

oncall-sre: Customer impact summary for incident bridge: ZetaBank (zeta-bank-prod) — traces missing 03:05-03:22 (partial from 03:05-03:23), logs partial/delayed, metrics delayed ~12m. Production requests unaffected; only observability degraded.

account-se-jen: Zeta notified. They want a postmortem and timeline. Asking for root cause and mitigation to prevent recurrence.

sre-arch-priya: Root cause preliminary: role-mapping service experienced a transient 5xx during a config push at 03:05Z which led to forwarder auth failures for tenant-scoped mapping. Because dedicated forwarder relied on live mapping (no robust cache fallback), spans from tenant were rejected. Secondary contributors: insufficient monitoring for mapping-service error-rate, and lack of tenant-scoped replay path.

noncall-sre: (typo) -> oncall-sre: Important — we should add a runbook item to auto-failover to cached mapping after 5s of mapping-service errors.

infra-ops-luis: Noted. I'll open infra ticket INFRA-2026-982 for mapping-service HA and cache fallback improvements.

runtime-eng-marc: Also recommend pipeline change: persist incoming span buffer for 2 minutes on forwarder so that transient auth failures don't drop spans immediately. Ticket RUNTIME-2026-451.

observability-nyk: For immediate mitigation we: 1) enabled presigned ingestion endpoint for Zeta (they opted not to use it after restart) 2) flushed forwarder caches 3) patched mapping-service fallback. Monitoring shows stable ingestion now.

oncall-sre: On-call handoff: I'm primary until 04:30Z (30m) then handoff to @sre-arch-priya for follow-ups and postmortem. Create incident doc in confluence and link to INC-2026-3456.

account-se-jen: I'll coordinate the postmortem call with Zeta for 09:00Z their local time and share the interim timeline.

cust-sre-tom: Thanks team. From Zeta's side they are OK with the timeline and want confirmation when retro changes are scheduled.

sre-arch-priya: I'll own retro tickets and timeline. ETA to infra changes and runtime buffer proposal: infra mapping-service HA change target next sprint (2 weeks), runtime buffer proposal review in 3 days.

oncall-sre: Closing note: incident severity reduced to P2 at 03:40Z after full ingestion recovery to baseline. Will transition to postmortem. If we see any regression, re-open paging. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3456 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. PS: please add notes to the incident doc with command outputs and exported logs link once available.
